title: Network lab 6: Lock down the switch (Packet Tracer)
summary: Shut unused ports, allow one known device per staff port with port security, protect the console and enable modes, and watch an unknown laptop get blocked.

script.intro: A switch with every port live and no passwords is an open building. Today we shut the empty doors, allow one known device per desk, and lock the management access.
script.outro: Hardening is a short checklist done every time. Next, an access list that keeps guests out of staff systems.
steps: A live, empty wall port is an open door: anyone can plug in. On the switch: Type the commands on screen, then check the result with the show command.
Type the commands on screen, then check the result with the show command.

Unplug staff-2 from Fa0/2 and plug a new Laptop into Fa0/2 instead. Give it 192.168.10.50 and ping staff-1. Look at the link light, then run show interfaces status and show port-security interface fa0/2.
Anyone with a console cable could change all of this. Add passwords: Type the commands on screen, then check the result with the show command.
Unused ports shut, known devices only, management protected. Lab 7 adds the access list that keeps guests away from staff.
